entry.title: Updated: dsh-remote-access-web#remote-access-web
entry.summary: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace. Exact install spec: @froststarinquire/dsh-remote-access-web. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
